solves.reasoning: (A) odd: interesting과 대조. (B) recovered: RSI 75% 회복. (C) pattern: the pattern of pain 관용적 표현
(A) reduces: 시각 정확도 감소. (B) removing: 촉발요인 제거. (C) despises: 화면 응시 혐오
(A) allegorically: 비유적으로 눈을 뜬다. (B) conflict: 욕구와 갈등. (C) triggers: 분노 촉발
① interesting 원문OK. ② recovered 원문OK. ③ vanished: 원문 occurred(발생)→vanished(사라짐) 반대. ④ strange 원문OK
① sensory 원문OK. ② admires: 원문 despises(혐오)→admires(감탄) 반대. ③ unconscious 원문OK. ④ anger 원문OK
① trigger 원문OK. ② acuity 원문OK. ③ senses 원문OK. ④ literally: 원문 allegorically(비유적)→literally(문자적) 반대
the screen is the _____ for the pain. 눈 감으면 안 아프다 = 화면이 촉발요인(trigger)
staring is in _____ with his unconscious wants. despises=혐오하므로 갈등(conflict)
removing the _____ trigger. 앞에서 senses 언급. 감각적(sensory) 촉발요인
ran across = encountered(우연히 마주치다). created/avoided/ignored 모두 부적절
acuity = sharpness(날카로움/선명도). visual acuity = 시각 선명도
despises = loathes(혐오하다). tolerates/appreciates/overlooks 모두 부적절
recovered(회복) ↔ worsened(악화). improved/progressed/stabilized는 반의어 아님
unconsciously(무의식) ↔ deliberately(의도적). instinctively/automatically/habitually는 유사어
(A) pattern of pain=반복되는 양상(매번 반복). (B) floral pattern=장식 무늬(커튼 디자인)
intense dislike or contempt = despise. admire/ignore/tolerate 부적절
when + V-ing: 주어생략 시 동명사. when using = when he was using
while + V-ing: 분사구문. while researching = while I was researching
closing his eyes _____ the source of information. 눈 감기=정보 차단=cuts out
cuts out _____. 화면응시=무의식갈등=분노유발. 차단대상='분노촉발 정보원천'(④)
